title: Deployment profile
description: A composable deployment profile. Profiles select controls by reference with a per-profile baseline disposition; they never copy control bodies. Composition rules (extend-acyclicity, no duplicate resolved references, lifecycle-legal references) are enforced by the registry validator.

extends.description: Profiles composed into this one. The resolved control set is the union of all extended profiles and this profile's own references, in declaration order; cycles are rejected by the registry validator.

baseline.description: true: omission violates this profile's declared baseline (evaluates to required when applicable); false: operator choice remains (evaluates to recommended).
